name: Demons
overview: Scripture reveals that demons, often referred to as devils, are entities to whom some have wrongly offered sacrifices, a practice strictly forbidden by God as seen in Leviticus 17:7 and Deuteronomy 32:17. The Bible also shows that God sovereignly controls spirits, including sending an evil spirit to influence events as recorded in Judges 9:23. Furthermore, 1 Kings 22 illustrates God's authority over spirits by placing a lying spirit in the mouths of false prophets to accomplish His purposes, demonstrating that even deceptive spirits operate under God's sovereign will.
